name: Cypht
description: Cypht is a lightweight webmail aggregator that combines several existing mail accounts in one web interface. It connects to IMAP/SMTP, JMAP and Exchange (EWS) servers as well as Gmail and Outlook via OAuth2, and shows unread, flagged and sent messages from all of them in combined views, with contacts, Sieve filters, feeds and PGP as optional modules.

notes.text: Sign in with the username and generated password stored as CYPHT_ADMIN_USER and CYPHT_ADMIN_PASS in /opt/cypht_data/.env.
Added mail accounts and settings are only kept after Save (or Save and Logout), encrypted with the login password. There is no password reset.
